name: M3-3D-23, 1PS
headline: Chilled & Serene 1BDR @ Mangroovy | Pool & Sea View
summary: This peaceful waterfront 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront compound with a 24/7 free pool and beach access and is managed by Xuru Stays

description.Space:
This chilled 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront residence - Mangroovy with a 24/7 free pool and beach access. Mangroovy is closest to the Marina (10 min walk). 

The apartment is on the second floor with furnished roof top overlooking the beach & new Fanadir Marina and features an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 2 bathrooms (one ensuite) and a living room with a sofa bed that can sleep up to 2 additional guests. 

It also features a 65 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for couples & small families. 

The styling of the apartment is tailored to give the guests a serene and calming vibe.


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
-Mangroovy residence is uniquely located 800 meters from Marina El Gouna. Guests will be able to walk 10 minutes and get to it. 
-'Bright Star' supermarket is right in front of the residence towards the Marina.
-Mangroovy is home to the famous 'Noi' beach lounge (located at Mangroovy's beach)
- 'The Smokery', a local favorite is also located 450 meters from the residence.
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna (flat fee 20 EGP).
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Positive:
The property itself is beautiful and the facilities in Mangroovy are beautiful and clean.

Negative:
The check-in was poor. I was not sent a link to complete the security deposit, and no code to get in, leaving me standing outside my room for an hour waiting for communication to be let in. 

I originally contacted the WhatsApp number provided (third party Airbnb house keeper, called Xuru) but had no reply. So I messaged via the Booking.com app, and eventually got a reply from I’m assuming the host. Xuru eventually replied 24 hours later, saying “hello.” They didn’t read the above messages, check if we got in, or call back. I’m grateful the owner replied so we were let in after an hour. 

The owners communication was great, however Xuru is a poor organiser.

The wifi stopped working - I asked for this to be sorted, followed up with, “let me check with the team” and no replies again.

All of the shampoo, conditioner, body wash, hand wash, and kitchen soap bottles were empty.
A very great place to stay in.
Enjoyed our stay. Thank you Xuru for being such a great and responsive host
Cozzy place, clean everything was fine the only comment about furniture is somehow not comfy “quick win”

Everything was nice the house was clean 
Only the sheet was not clean and they change it in a few minutes after complaining so the customer support and the house keeping team are so helpful and the stay was nice we just had a 30 minutes late check in because the support was on a busy line but at the end the experience was nice and comfy thank you

pros:

Unterkunft guter Zustand; geschmackvoll eingerichtet, für 2 Personen großzügige Platzverhältnisse. 
Gutes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis, alle Pools der Anlage nutzbar, Strandnähe. Sehr ruhig zumindest Anfang bis Mitte September.

cons: 

Baustelle in der Nähe, hat uns jedoch nicht gestört, da wir immer unterwegs waren. Kehrgarnitur angefordert, wurde zugesagt, aber nie geliefert.
Keine Storage-Möglichkeit für das Gepäck für späte Rückflüge, mussten um 11 Uhr auschecken und unser Gepäck bei 40° vor dem Gebäude bewachen; unser Flug ging aber erst um 19:30. Späte Flüge sind ja nichts ungewöhnliches. Versuch einer Lösungsfindung scheiterte, da sich Xuru-Stays dahingehend total unflexibel gezeigt hat. Hinterlässt das Gefühl, dass die starke Kundenfreundlichkeit bei der Vermietungsanbahnung nach Abschluss doch deutlich nachlässt. Hat uns schon geärgert.

Auch wenn wir uns wohl gefühlt haben gibt es hier noch Luft nach oben. Deshalb können wir leider keine 5-Sterne-Bewertung vergeben.

Positive:
Great location, really enjoyed the terrace! The place was clean & exactly like the photo's.

Negative:
Becareful with the host, it is managed by a company who is obviously not very organized. I was very surprised to find the host make a false "damage payment" claim through booking that we broke an umbrella - which the unit did not even have! When I asked the contact person, she sent me a picture that is not even from the unit. I am guessing they're just trying their luck, so watch-out on that.

Positive:
Mangroovy is fabulous. Brand new, excellent sandy beach, brilliant beach club (at extra cost) and multiple swimming pools, although too cold to enjoy in December. 
The apartment was new, incredibly clean and well appointed - everything you need for a stay. There is a small shop a minute’s walk away.

Negative:
We complained about noise (which lasted 4 days of our stay) from the two adjacent apartments being fitted. Xuru stays said they would help but nothing was ever done, so we were disturbed by loud drilling and banging for most of our stay. 
The bed slats are not correctly fitted so we had to move them to keep the bed from dropping. 
There is a building site opposite so additional noise from outside. 
It wasn’t exactly ‘chilled and serene’ in December 2924 but won’t always be like that.
